note: The four model weight files were served from a verified local copy on disk (sha256 equal to Hugging Face's) during recording, because the download was too slow; same bytes, same model. Four prompts, each ended with a build step and one more shape in the scene. The model places every new shape at the origin, so a second wall or column would land on the first; prompts that built nothing, or built something other than what was asked, are not shown.

prompts.prompt: Build a wall, 5.5m long, 0.2m thick, 2.8m tall.
Place a 6 by 6m floor slab, 0.2m thick.
A circular column with 0.45m radius and 5m height.
Place a horizontal beam 5m long, 0.3m wide and 0.4m deep, 3m above ground.
